findings.title: French supermarket chains say cyberattack shut down refrigerators
findings.summary_md: Hackers forced the temperature of fridges and freezers in many French supermarkets up to 50 C overnight, causing fires and spoiling food at several hundred stores. The attack hit multiple major chains and was described by officials as unprecedented in scale.

findings.title: Cyberattack shuts down refrigerators at French supermarkets
findings.summary_md: Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight, targeting Danfoss refrigeration controllers and affecting an estimated 250 to 350 stores. The article cited CISA's authentication bypass advisory for Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA and Claroty Team82's research, and noted roughly 2,752 Danfoss systems exposed online including 1,590 in France.

findings.title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
findings.summary_md: Hundreds of French supermarkets were hit by a cyberattack that caused fridges and freezers to heat up, spoiling fresh and frozen food. Affected chains included Intermarche, Cooperative U, Carrefour Market, Monoprix, Leclerc, and Super U.

findings.title: Hackers force French supermarket fridges to heat up to 50C in unprecedented cyber-attack
findings.summary_md: Hackers forced the temperature of many French supermarket fridges up to 50 C overnight in a cyberattack affecting several hundred stores across the country, with fires and food losses reported. The incident was described by officials as unprecedented.

findings.title: Incident de securite ciblant les controleurs a distance des installations de refrigeration (CERTFR-2026-ALE-012)
findings.summary_md: CERT-FR reported numerous compromises of remote controllers for refrigeration installations, naming Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC series plus Copeland and Dixell xweb consoles, and urged operators to remove internet exposure and apply firmware updates.

findings.title: Freeze the Controller, Defrost the Food: Uncovering Vulnerabilities in Danfoss Refrigeration Controllers
findings.summary_md: Claroty Team82 disclosed multiple vulnerabilities in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A refrigeration controller web management interface, including an authentication bypass via a predictable code-of-the-day mechanism, and reported that Danfoss addressed them in new firmware.

findings.title: Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series (Update A) (ICSA-25-140-03)
findings.summary_md: CISA published ICS advisory ICSA-25-140-03 for Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series, detailing CVE-2025-41450 authentication bypass via datetime-based password generation affecting versions prior to R4.2, with Danfoss releasing R4.2 and later R4.3.1.
